Subject: Failed payment on renewal (Invoice #INV-20261231) — possible dispute

Hi Markus,

We just received an auto-notice from our billing team that the renewal for invoice INV-20261231 (USD 18,450.00) failed during auth on 2027-01-14. Stripe decline code was card_declined, last4 4242, auth attempt id: at_1Jk9zZ. On top of that, we got an email from our finance ops: a customer cardholder has opened a chargeback case for the same amount (we were CC'd on the dispute notice).

Can Redwood attempt a manual retry? If the dispute proceeds, our team will need evidence packets (subscription agreement, delivery logs, signed SOW, invoice). Also: the invoice VAT field looks wrong on our end — sales tax/VAT was left blank but our accounting shows EU VAT applies (we're in Ireland). That may be why the cardholder flagged the charge.

Attachments: stripe-decline-log-20270115.csv (from our gateway), invoice_20261231_BRIGHTLEAF.pdf

We'd like to get this resolved quickly — can you outline next steps and who will own the retry/evidence submission?

Thanks,

Hi Sarah — thanks for the heads up and for the attachments. Looping in Monica (acct lead) and Ben (payments ops). Proposed immediate plan: 

1) Ben will attempt a single manual retry against the existing authorization and, if that fails, generate a one-time card-update link for the customer.
2) Monica will collect/document evidence for the dispute packet (SOW, signed order, delivery logs, usage reports) and submit via the Stripe dispute UI.
3) I'll coordinate VAT/tax clarification — if the invoice needs a VAT correction we should issue a credit and reissue the invoice before retrying to avoid a repeat dispute.

Ben/Monica — can each confirm ownership and ETA? If we need a waiver (one-time retry without late fee) from finance, I can sign off but want to keep it minimal.
